ctc-alignment

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:ctc-alignment` → `ai-ctc-alignment` → `src/demos/ai/ai-ctc-alignment`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/166`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#30-ctc-alignment`. **Packet:** S1. **Level / prerequisites:** stretch; `ai:spectrogram-picture`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** spectrogram-picture computes time features; this sums all permitted frame paths for a transcript instead of requiring a unique labelled alignment.

**Computed primary model:** Two frames, alphabet{blank,A}, each independent frame P(A)=.6, P(blank)=.4. CTC collapse first merges adjacent repeats, then removes blanks. PathsAA,Ablank,blankA all yield transcriptA with masses.36,.24,.24: total.84. Blankblank yields empty.16. TranscriptAA is impossible in2frames under this alphabet/collapse.

**Countercase / boundary:** At3frames, AblankA is the only path yielding transcriptAA, probability.6*.4*.6=.144. Removing blanks before merging repeats would incorrectly collapse that toA. Empty transcript probability.4³=.064; remaining singleA mass.792. These are supplied per-frame probabilities, not a trained speech model or probability of a particular timing label.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether AA path means two emitted As; recall with2frames and P(A)=.1, transcriptA probability.19, empty.81.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Enumerate paths computes path products, collapse stages and grouped transcript probabilities; Add frame/Change probabilities expose alignment ambiguity while retaining2-frame.84 witness. At most8paths, with explicit blank and repeat order in ordinary visible evidence.

**Source obligation:** [Graves et al. original CTC PDF](https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~graves/icml_2006.pdf), opened2026-10-19, §2 path distribution and many-to-one collapse mapping, transcript likelihood sum. Only the local2/3-frame calculation is admitted, not empirical speech accuracy or learned alignment.
